contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A damaged and worn copper alloy strap fitting / distributor of Roman date (AD 43-350). The object is in one piece being broadly cruciform in shape, sub-rectangular in cross section and hollow within.
